services.desc: Explore, Discover & Grow - One-Hour Guided Tour at BCMTake your child on an unforgettable learning journey at BCM - the nation’s first and only children’s museum focused on American cultural history, designed especially for curious kids ages 4-9. Our Visitor Policy outlines important guidelines and expectations to ensure a safe, welcoming, and enjoyable experience for all guests-read our Visitor Policy here. Tickets may be purchased at the museum entrance. We accept cash, Zelle, and PayPal. Please note that PayPal transactions include a 3% processing fee.
